authoring_runs_complete.name: authoring_runs_complete
authoring_runs_complete.value: ("authoring_runs"."state" = 'complete' AND "authoring_runs"."sha" IS NOT NULL AND "authoring_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR "authoring_runs"."state" <> 'complete'

grade_runs_result.name: grade_runs_result
grade_runs_result.value: ("grade_runs"."state" = 'complete' AND "grade_runs"."sha" IS NOT NULL AND "grade_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "grade_runs"."result" IS NOT NULL AND "grade_runs"."result"->>'score' IS NOT NULL) OR ("grade_runs"."state" <> 'complete' AND "grade_runs"."result" IS NULL)
